user.title: Navimower private-cloud login
user.description: Enter the email and password for the Navimow account used by Home Assistant. A dedicated shared account is recommended because signing into the mobile app with the same account can invalidate the private-cloud session. The password is used only for login and is not stored.

data_description.password: Used once to create or renew the private-cloud session.

select_vehicle.title: Choose a mower
select_vehicle.description: More than one mower was found on this private-cloud account.

manual.title: Enter the shared mower serial
manual.description: No mower was listed on this account. This is normal for some shared accounts. Enter the serial number shown in the Navimow app; Navimower validates it with a read-only cloud request.

link_oauth.title: Connect official live data
link_oauth.description: Continue to the official Navimow Smart Home authorization page. This second connection supplies live MQTT X, Y and heading and is stored in the same standalone Navimower entry. The OAuth account must be able to access the same mower.

reauth_select.title: Repair Navimower authentication
reauth_select.description: Choose which independent connection should be renewed.

reauth_private.title: Renew private-cloud login
reauth_private.description: Enter the private-cloud account password again. The password is not stored.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Navimow cloud. Try again.
error.vehicle_not_found: That mower could not be read on this account. Check the serial and sharing permissions.
error.oauth_cannot_connect: The official Smart Home mower list could not be read.
error.oauth_mower_not_found: The OAuth account could not be matched to the selected private-cloud mower.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.oauth_cannot_connect: The official Smart Home mower list could not be read.
abort.oauth_mower_not_found: The OAuth account could not be matched to the selected private-cloud mower.
abort.unknown: The setup flow could not be completed.

init.title: Navimower options
init.description: Configure retained trail history, zone-pair gates and optional local X/Y channels.

general.title: General and trail history
general.description: Choose how long exact MQTT mowing sessions are retained in Home Assistant. Unlimited keeps every completed session until it is manually removed with the integration.

data_description.include_return_trail: Keep the mower route after cutting ends while it travels back to the dock.
data_description.diagnostics_detail: Extended keeps additional integration context in manual exports; tokens and account identifiers remain redacted.

gates.title: Gates
gates.description: Add, edit or delete physical gates between mapped zones.

gate_add.title: Add a gate
gate_add.description: Select the two mapped zones connected by this physical gate. With bidirectional enabled, either transition can request the gate. When disabled, the direction is Zone A to Zone B.

gate_edit.title: Edit gate
gate_edit.description: When bidirectional is disabled, the allowed direction is Zone A to Zone B.

channels.title: Local channels
channels.description: Add, edit or delete optional local-coordinate rectangles.

channel_add.title: Add a local channel
channel_add.description: Channels are optional rectangular areas in the mower local X and Y coordinate system. They remain available alongside intention-based zone-pair gates.

error.same_zone: Zone A and Zone B must be different.
error.duplicate_gate: A gate with the same name or zone pair already exists.
error.duplicate_channel: A channel with the same name already exists.

abort.options_saved: Navimower options were saved and the integration is reloading.
abort.zones_not_available: At least two mapped zones must be loaded before a gate can be configured.
